_about: Planet generation 2's placement (docs/world/planet-gen2.md, window 4; read by sim/world/sites.gd). sites: how a candidate place is scored in a gen 2 planet, on top of the stored planet's own score (spacing and height): city and town each have a weight per fine biome (climate.json's fine list, in its order; a weight at or under reject makes the candidate impossible) and a coast term: dirs points on a ring of radius reach round the candidate are read, and the share of them in the sea scores bonus when it is between low and high (a harbour: some sea, not an islet), 0 at no sea, and penalty over high. ecotones: a ring's fine biomes blend at their borders: a column within width columns of a different biome of the set takes that biome with a chance that falls from max at the border to 0 at width (a keyed draw per column), so a border is a ragged band and not a ruled line; the stored biome follows.
